eastern-ok.audit: T1 exact-identity versus geometric named-stroke continuity merge; diagnostic only

method.ambiguous_junction_definition: same-identity connector node with >2 distinct incident rows or >1 eligible pairwise continuation
method.deflection_convention: 0 degrees is straight continuation; 30 degrees exactly is excluded
method.duplicate_geometry_definition: identical normalized EPSG:5070 WKB among identified road rows; report excess rows, do not silently remove them
method.exact_identity: frozen T1 name.primary, else route network/ref; global identity aggregation
method.gap_rule: exact identity retains all named length and only outside-share-eligible class-drop length; geometric merge uses eligible stroke named plus class-drop length after the outside-share gate
method.merged_identity: same identity only; union rows sharing connector endpoint when outward-tangent deflection is strictly <30 degrees
